Keep original PDF pages

Existing pages stay readable. Choice circles appear beside recognized MCQ options.

Know what converts

DOCX, PPTX and spreadsheets are reflowed; complex formatting may change. Scans stay as images. No OCR or automatic MCQ generation.

Works best in Acrobat Reader

PDF form support varies by viewer. Download and open in Adobe Acrobat Reader to fill notes and save answers.

Supported formats & conversion details

PDF: original pages and existing forms retained; recognized MCQs gain selectable A-E radio buttons. Printed answers remain visible. Digital signatures will no longer be valid after modification; use an unsigned copy. Password-protected PDFs are rejected. DOCX: text and embedded images. PPTX: slide text and embedded raster images in slide order; charts and vector artwork are not reproduced. XLSX/XLS/CSV/TSV: cell values, sheet by sheet, without workbook formatting; formulas use saved values. TXT/MD/JSON/HTML: readable text (HTML scripts are never executed). PNG/JPEG/WebP/BMP/GIF: one image per page; animated images use their first frame. Reflowed text is rendered as an image to support Unicode and is not searchable. Old DOC/PPT, audio, video, archives and executables cannot be converted here. Export them to PDF in their original app first.
